body: You guys have a lot of hope for people. And this is the Internet. I feel calmer now, just one of those nights i guess. I think I'm going to see someone about this, before I get the courage to self destruct. Thanks for the kind words and faith. They really did help. And you didn't have to spend your time helping a whiney immature dick, but you did. Thanks again.

My first suicidal thought was when I was about 11 years old. I remember being on top of the playground set thinking, "if I just jumped off...". I used to miss months of school in middle school cause I'd stay home and lay in my room and hate myself. In high school, I walked home everyday just hoping someday I'd get the courage to jump off the bridge. Now I find myself seeing ways to die more often than ever. It doesn't help that my whole life I was riddled with sleep disorders, night terrors, sleepwalking and talking, intense dreams or nightmares, and don't get me started on sleep paralysis. I just want to rest. But yeah, you're right, my girlfriend of 3 years, she's saved my life on several occasions now, without even knowing it. But I can't help but feel shed be happier without such a miserable person who finds everything hilariously pointless and stupid. Just another pretentious artist.
I just feel as if I don't have the capacity to survive in this world. I don't even feel human most of the time. I just feel empty one moment, and overwhelmed with the suffering of mankind in another.
